resources.name: Amori API
resources.description: Amori .NET API endpoints

resources.name: Health
resources.description: No auth required

resources.name: Health Check
resources.description: Returns 200 OK if the API is running.

resources.name: Auth
resources.description: Register and login — no token required

resources.name: Register
resources.description:
Creates a new user account. Returns accessToken + user object.

Copy the accessToken into the 'access_token' environment variable.

resources.name: Login
resources.description:
Authenticates an existing user. Returns accessToken + user object.

Copy the accessToken into the 'access_token' environment variable.

resources.name: Users
resources.description: Requires Bearer token

resources.name: Get Current User
resources.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

resources.name: Relationships
resources.description: Requires Bearer token

resources.name: Create Relationship
resources.description: Creates a new relationship for the current user. The user becomes the first member.

resources.name: Get My Relationship
resources.description: Returns the relationship the current user belongs to.

resources.name: Join Relationship
resources.description: Joins an existing relationship by ID. Max 2 members. Set relationship_id in environment.

resources.name: Incidents
resources.description: Relationship incident management. Requires Bearer token.

resources.name: List Incidents
resources.description:
List incidents for the authenticated user's relationship.

Query params: status, category, priority, impact, urgency, reportedByMe, assignedToMe, openOnly, overdue, page, pageSize

resources.name: Get Summary Stats
resources.description: Relationship-level incident statistics.

resources.name: Create Incident

body.text:
{
  "title": "We need to talk about communication",
  "description": "I feel like we've been struggling to connect lately.",
  "category": 0,
  "subCategory": "Communication",
  "impact": 1,
  "urgency": 1
}

resources.description:
Create a new incident.

category: enum IncidentCategory
impact: enum IncidentImpact
urgency: enum IncidentUrgency

resources.name: Get Incident by ID
resources.description: Get full detail for a single incident.

resources.name: Update Incident
resources.description: Update editable fields: title, description, category, impact, urgency.

resources.name: Assign Incident
resources.description: Assign the incident to the partner. Sets status to ASSIGNED.

resources.name: Start Investigation
resources.description: Begin investigation. Sets status to INVESTIGATING.

resources.name: Awaiting Response
resources.description: Mark incident as awaiting a response from the partner.

resources.name: Resolve Incident
resources.description: Resolve the incident with a resolution summary.

resources.name: Close Incident
resources.description: Close the incident. Resolution accepted and documented.

resources.name: Reopen Incident
resources.description: Reopen a closed or resolved incident.

resources.name: Get Notes
resources.description: Get all investigation notes for an incident.

resources.name: Add Note
resources.description: Add an investigation note to an incident.

resources.name: Update Note
resources.description: Update an investigation note (author only). Replace NOTE_ID_HERE.

resources.name: Delete Note
resources.description: Delete an investigation note (author only). Replace NOTE_ID_HERE.

resources.name: Get Responses
resources.description: Get all responses to an incident.

resources.name: Add Response
resources.description: Add a response to an incident.

resources.name: Update Response
resources.description: Update a response (author only). Replace RESPONSE_ID_HERE.

resources.name: Delete Response
resources.description: Delete a response (author only). Replace RESPONSE_ID_HERE.

resources.name: Get History
resources.description: Get the append-only audit history for an incident.

resources.name: Get SLA
resources.description: Get SLA countdown information for an incident.

resources.name: Add Review (PIR)
resources.description: Add a post-implementation review. Only available after resolved/closed.

resources.name: Get Lessons Learned
resources.description: Get all lessons learned for an incident.

resources.name: Add Lesson Learned
resources.description: Record a lesson learned for an incident.

resources.name: Relationship Tickets (Let's Chat)
resources.description: Communication ticket system. Requires Bearer token.

resources.name: List Tickets
resources.description: List all tickets. Optional query: ?status=0 (Open=0, Acknowledged=1, InProgress=2, Resolved=3, Closed=4)

resources.name: Get Ticket by ID
resources.description: Get a single ticket with all responses.

resources.name: Create Ticket

body.text:
{
  "subject": "I need more quality time together",
  "category": 0,
  "severity": 1,
  "description": "I've been feeling disconnected lately.",
  "feelings": "Lonely and a bit unseen.",
  "whatHappened": "We've both been busy and haven't had a proper date in weeks.",
  "whatINeed": "A dedicated date night each week.",
  "whatIPreferInFuture": "Let's plan ahead so we both have something to look forward to.",
  "additionalNotes": null
}

resources.description: Create a new ticket. category: enum TicketCategory. severity: Low=0, Medium=1, High=2, Critical=3.

resources.name: Update Ticket
resources.description: Update a ticket (creator only).

resources.name: Delete Ticket
resources.description: Delete a ticket (creator only).

resources.name: Acknowledge Ticket
resources.description: Acknowledge a ticket. Sets status to Acknowledged.

resources.name: Assign Ticket
resources.description: Assign a ticket to a relationship member. Sets status to InProgress.

resources.name: Respond to Ticket
resources.description: Add a response to a ticket.

resources.name: Get Responses
resources.description: Get all responses for a ticket.

resources.name: Set Status
resources.description: Set the ticket status directly. Send integer: Open=0, Acknowledged=1, InProgress=2, Resolved=3, Closed=4.

resources.name: Resolve Ticket
resources.description: Resolve a ticket. Sets status to Resolved.

resources.name: Reopen Ticket
resources.description: Reopen a resolved ticket.
